summary: Build a concise brief from the calendar event, participants, prior conversations, current work, files, and relevant web context.

useCases.title: Prepare for an upcoming meeting
useCases.message: Prepare me for my upcoming meeting with the context that could change the conversation, the outcome to aim for, and the questions worth asking.

useCases.title: Get a concise meeting brief
useCases.message: Use the relevant calendar, relationship, project, message, document, and web context to prepare a brief for this meeting.

useCases.title: Prepare for a founder or partner meeting
useCases.message: Prepare me for this founder, partner, expert, or portfolio meeting using the investment, relationship, market, and recent company context that could change the conversation.

useCases.title: Prepare for a client or delivery meeting
useCases.message: Prepare me for this client, workshop, steering, delivery, or internal meeting using the context that could change the conversation.

useCases.title: Prepare for a general sales-team meeting
useCases.message: Prepare me for this internal, partner, or cross-functional meeting using the context that could change the conversation. Use the Sales meeting skill instead when account or deal judgment dominates.

useCases.title: Walk into a meeting prepared
useCases.message: Help me understand what matters for this meeting, what has changed, what to bring, and what I should try to resolve.
